newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: BULGARIA'S STOYANOV TO VISIT PRAGUE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA'S STOYANOV TO VISIT PRAGUE.

text.p: Bulgaria's President Petar Stoyanov will pay a working visit to Prague later this month to meet with his counterpart Vaclav Havel, the Czech president's office said on Monday.
Stojanov, who took office on January 19, is also scheduled to meet other Czech leaders during his visit on February 28, the presidential office said in a statement.
Havel has yet to return to full duties since surgery removed a small cancerous tumour along with half of his right lung in early December. He is expected to return to work full-time in early March.
